stem.text: Air is trapped inside a glass bulb which is immersed in water and attached to a U-tube containing mercury. The densities of water and mercury are $\rho_\text{w}$ and $\rho_\text{m}$ respectively. The surface of the water is open to the atmosphere where atmospheric pressure is $P$.

stem.alt: Glass bulb containing air, joined to a U-tube containing mercury, immersed in water in an open container; labels atmospheric pressure P, water surface, water density ρw, glass bulb, air, hw, hm, U-tube and mercury density ρm.

stem.text: The acceleration of free fall is $g$.
